React Native and Expo

Components for React Native.

The Colibri catalog, rebuilt for phones: every components and ready-made screens, themed from one hue. No dependencies beyond React Native, no build step, no configuration.

npm install @colibri-kit/native
import { ColibriProvider, Screen, Stack, Heading, Button } from "@colibri-kit/native";

<ColibriProvider hue={160}>
  <Screen>
    <Stack gap="m">
      <Heading>Hello</Heading>
      <Button title="Continue" variant="soft" onPress={next} />
    </Stack>
  </Screen>
</ColibriProvider>

Pick a component below to try it on the phone, then switch to Code for a sample you can paste. The phone runs the real component code in your browser through react-native-web. Documentation on GitHub.
